experiment.name: ACLS on CL Simulator - Adaptive Closed-Loop Stimulation for Burst Suppression
experiment.hypothesis: HYP-000: Can ACLS protocol reduce burst rate in CL Simulator?

protocol.name: ACLS (Adaptive Closed-Loop Stimulation)
protocol.description: Adaptive stimulation that adjusts parameters based on real-time burst detection to suppress pathological bursting

success_criteria.contradiction_detection: At least 1 contradiction recorded if hypothesis falsified

falsification_criterion: Burst rate reduction <5% after 5 minutes of adaptive stimulation

expected_outcomes.if_supported: ACLS control logic validated; proceed to Cartpole experiment (EXP-002)
expected_outcomes.if_falsified: ACLS parameters need tuning; test alternative adaptation rules
expected_outcomes.if_inconclusive: Extend duration; check simulator burst statistics
